context.transcript:
message.
Hi—this is Monique. I was your nurse during your visit to
Dr. Balani's office earlier today. Ol'm calling to let you know
we've contacted the pharmacy near your home and placed
the order for your new medication. ® The pharmacist said
the prescription will be ready at one o'clock, so you can get it
then. Also, ®our clinic would like your feedback. ® You'll be
mailed a patient satisfaction survey about the care provided
to you today by our doctors, nurses, and receptionists. We'd
appreciate it if you'd fill out the survey and mail it back to us.
Thanks, and have a good day.
